name: Daming Palace
description: Daming Palace, the main palace of the Tang Empire, is known as the palace of a thousand palaces. It is the most splendid and magnificent palace complex in Chang'an City. It is large in scale and complete in layout. It is called "the pinnacle of Chinese palace architecture". It was built in the eighth year of Zhenguan (634 years) of Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty. The entire palace includes more than 30 buildings such as Dafu Hall, Sanqing Hall, and Chengxiang Hall. In 1961, the Daming Palace site was listed as a national key cultural relic protection unit; in 2014, it was successfully included in the World Heritage List.
